feeds.title: Not So Formulaic Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ginny - wife to Dan and mom to three great kiddos. I'm passionately Catholic, a Gifted and Twice Exceptional advocate, and a former high school English teacher turned homeschooling mom. Let's pursue the true, the good, and the beautiful as we break down stereotypes.

feeds.title: Equipping Catholic Families
feeds.description: Celebrating Catholic Family and Faith with crafts, Catechesis, and traditions! I am a wife, mom of 5 kids, an author, and a crafter. We offer beautifully designed, authentic Catholic teaching tools, captivating the attention of children and providing quality resources for parents and all educators in the Catholic Faith.

feeds.title: Catholic Icing
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lacy and I run Catholic Icing, a site devoted to bringing Catholic crafts and activities to Catholic kids.

feeds.title: Catholic Living
feeds.description: Baritone and Soprano are, like a goodly number of married couples, trying to raise a Catholic family in a pagan society. To that end, this blog can be a useful resource for other Catholics and helpful perhaps even for those who are not Catholic. This is a personal blog and the opinions given are solely those of the authors. This Catholic Living blog is Catholic insofar as its authors are Catholics who accept all that the Catholic Church teaches.

feeds.title: Catholic Family News
feeds.description: Founded in 1994, Catholic Family News is a monthly journal dedicated to preserving the Catholic Faith of all time, 'in the same meaning and the same explanation' as Catholic doctrine has been taught throughout the ages. We bring readers up-to-date on what is really going on in the Church and the world, and more importantly, how such events affect the religious rights of yourselves and your children.

feeds.title: Mercy for Marthas
feeds.description: In this blog, we hope to share with you some of our experiences and insights as Catholic homeschooling mothers. We hope to inspire you to a life of prayer and to offer support and encouragement. Since, like St. Martha, we are practical women, we will also post lessons plans and resources that we have created over the years. We hope you will find them useful and that they will simplify your life....maybe even a little.

feeds.title: CathFamily
feeds.description: Welcome to CathFamily, a website dedicated to assisting families in making the home the living heart of the church. As a church, we have benefited over the centuries from simple home-based rituals to provide practical faith experiences for our children. This site aims to provide innovative and contemporary resources to continue this tradition.

feeds.title: Catholic Action for Faith and Family Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Action for Faith and Family is an association of Catholics that strives to uphold and defend Christian values inspired by the teachings of the Roman Catholic Church. It aims to provide a network of resources and activities for clergy and laity to inspire them to reach out to others in an active way to defend these values.

feeds.title: JOYfilledfamily Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lena, mama of JOYfilledfamily. We are a traditional Catholic family striving to live for Jesus Christ in everything we do. We pray to completely surrender our will to His and to become His servants. Our mission of this blog is to share our JOY. This blog serves as a journal of us making good memories, living the liturgical year, and our spiritual journey.

feeds.title: A Catholic Moms Life Blog
feeds.description: A Catholic Mom's Life is a blog by Heather Johnson, a mom of five. She shares family traditions, recipes, prayers, and tips to help other moms live their faith at home. Her posts are friendly and practical, showing simple ways to bring Catholic life into everyday family routines.

feeds.title: Traditional Catholic Femininity » Motherhood/Family
feeds.description: Traditional Catholic Femininity and Biblical Womanhood share posts on Motherhood/Family here. Hi! I'm Paige. My main goals and vision for Traditional Catholic Femininity are to provide support, to inspire and be inspired by Traditional Catholic women of all ages in their vocations, as well as to promote Marian virtues, Biblical femininity, Godly womanhood, and traditional, old-fashioned values.

feeds.title: Catholic Digest » Family
feeds.description: Browse insightful articles on Parenting, Recipes, Relationships, and Sundays. Catholic Digest connects readers to personal stories of triumphs and struggles, joys and challenges, and the lighter side of Catholic living. We are a source of support and encouragement for those who love, struggle with, and learn from their faith.

feeds.title: Family Rosary Blog » Family Life
feeds.description: Family Rosary Blog shares reflections on Family, Faith, and The ever-changing world. Find articles with brief and contemporary inspiration focused on hope and family prayer. Family Rosary inspires families to pray together, to help them pray together, and to help them understand the value of spending time in prayer as a family.

feeds.title: NOLA Catholic Parenting
feeds.description: The mission of NOLA Catholic Parenting is to provide a platform that encourages healthy conversation, spiritual support, growth, fellowship, and, above all, to experience God's grace in an accepting and reflective parenting community. Read Parenting thoughts, prayer and motivational articles from our Authors in this blog.

feeds.title: Agape Catholic Ministries » Family Life
feeds.description: Learn how to create a balanced, devoted, Church-going Family life with the help of tips and resources given in these Blog articles. Agapè Catholic Marriage Preparation invites couples to a deeper relationship with each other and with Christ, one couple at a time.

feeds.title: Carrots For Michaelmas
feeds.description: Cultivating a Catholic family through literature, liturgical living, and urban homesteading. This blog is run by a Catholic wife and mother who shares her experiences related to faith, family, and life. The blog covers topics like parenting, homemaking, recipes, and Catholic culture.

feeds.title: Catholic All Year Blog
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Kendra. I am a catholic wife and mother of seven. I also dabble in teaching, reading, writing, cooking, baking, homeschooling, and leading a catholic life. This blog is a place for me to share how we live.

feeds.title: Wildflowers and Marbles
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer Mackintosh, and I'm a Catholic home educator, finding the simple joys in living here in the beautiful foothills of the Appalachian Mountains. Sharing the beauty found in the ordinary moments - planning, organizing, homeschooling, and living the Catholic faith.

feeds.title: A blog for my mom
feeds.description: I'm Rosie! Catholic mom of seven. Learn along with me as I raise Catholic kids, dabble in homeschooling, discover the joys of parenting twins, and laugh at toddler antics!

feeds.title: Fear Not Little Flock
feeds.description: Fear Not Little Flock is a priest's wife's blogabout spirituality, religion and family from a Byzantine Catholic's perspective.

feeds.title: Traditional Catholic Homestead
feeds.description: Share in the journey of a Traditional Catholic Homesteading family. We explore topics like: Homeschooling, Permaculture, Land Management Techniques, and more! We love the beauty of the Tridentine Mass, the truth in the teachings of traditional Catholicism, and look forward to the restoration and reunification of our faith.

feeds.title: All This And Heaven
feeds.description: This blog was created to share some moments of our life with you. Often having 11 children (including twins), homeschooling, and being incredibly active in our Catholic faith we are asked 'How do you do it?' We invite you to look around, sign up as a follower, and peek into the answer to that question. Remember we are not a perfect family; but I won't post the bad stuff.

feeds.title: Raising a Large Family Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My Name is Diana. We are a growing family with 14 children. And as a mother of 14, I help mothers combat today's godless society through friendship and education on this blog.

feeds.title: Modern Catholic Mom Blog
feeds.description: My name is Moira. I love faith, food, family, fashion, and friends. I hope this blog will encourage you to embrace your own, crazy amazing life and to let go of everything that the world is telling you that you should be, so you can become the woman that was meant to be.

feeds.title: Catholic Family Crate Blog
feeds.description: As Catholic parents ourselves, we understand how difficult passing on the faith is with the many contradictory messages the culture sends to our children. We understand the fear and urgency. We understand what it feels like and how scary it is. Our crates have helped thousands of Catholic parents bring faith to their kids with our beautiful and effective materials.

feeds.title: This Catholic Family
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lorelei, Catholic convert and debut author. I'm a former classroom teacher and instructional coach.The blog is run by a Catholic family that shares their experiences related to faith, family, and life. The blog covers topics like parenting, marriage, home education, and Catholic culture.

feeds.title: Fit Catholic Mom Blog
feeds.description: Rebecca Dussault is an Olympian and World Champion and is the founder of FitCatholicMom.com where you will find transformation for the Catholic moms. Training and coaching the Catholic mom in learning ways to 'fit' in fitness irrespective of a busy schedule.

feeds.title: Me & My House Blog
feeds.description: The Me & My House blog is about bringing together thoughts and ideas on parenting from a Catholic perspective. Our approach is joyful, always aims to be helpful, and is just full of faith. We are a Catholic organization that loves parents and the beautiful gift that God gives to them: the child.

feeds.title: The Kennedy Adventures
feeds.description: Kennedy Adventures by Dianna Kennedy Offers practical solutions for today's Catholic parents. Includes articles on Catholic Living, Homeschooling, Parenting, and loads of other helpful resources. Dianna homeschooling mother of 6 kids and shares tips on managing a large family.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Clare Blog
feeds.description: Elizabeth Clare is a Catholic writer and speaker who runs this blog to share her experiences and insights related to faith, family, and culture. Her blog covers topics like prayer, family life, evangelization, and Catholic culture.

feeds.title: Family in Feast and Feria
feeds.description: My name is Jennifer Gregory Miller, a wife of 14 years and mother of one 12-year-old son, and another son, age 8 years. This blog is just a casual recording of our daily ebbs and flows in our Catholic family and thoughts and ponderings along our journey and might include a little of this and that.

feeds.title: Catholic Husband
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Chet. This is a personal blog focused on sharing my experiences and lessons learned in the married life. I've been writing here since 2013 with Alison, my wife, serving as my editor since the very beginning. Catholic Husband covers range of topics including fatherhood, Catholic life, and careers. All of these posts have been written with the intention of helping you to love, lead, & serve your family.

feeds.title: Messy Family Project Blog
feeds.description: Parenting is not a clean-cut, simple process for those who like to follow the rules. Parenting is messy and unpredictable, but it is the greatest adventure you will ever have. We are Mike and Alicia Hernon, parents of 10 children ranging from 2 to 20 and we would like to invite you into some of the conversations we have had with each other about parenting and Catholic family life.

feeds.title: The Natural Catholic Mom
feeds.description: My name is Mariette, and I am excited to share my Faith, family, and pursuits in natural living with you here! I am passionate about my Catholic Faith and am especially devoted to the Traditional Latin Mass. Slowly we are trying to build up our home, our domestic church, to be a place where we grow not only in health, but most importantly, holiness.

feeds.title: America Magazine » Family Life
feeds.description: Read entertaining magazine articles with a special focus on Faith, Family, and Christ. Featuring exclusive short takes on many current topics from Politics & Society. The American Magazine is a forum for discussion of religion, society, politics, and culture from a Catholic perspective founded by The Jesuit Order.
